summary: Berto Acquisition Corp. II filed Form 8-K to announce the separate trading of its ordinary shares and warrants effective July 6, 2026. Each unit consists of one ordinary share ($0.0001 par value) and one-third of one redeemable warrant exercisable at $11.50 per share. No fractional warrants will be issued. This is a routine unit separation event common for SPACs post-IPO, not a special situation. The filing includes a press release and standard cover page. There are no deal terms, board recommendations, or structural changes beyond the trading mechanics. No further action or regulatory clock applies.
